description: Pub. 544 (2025), § 1245 example: a light-duty truck bought for $10,000, MACRS deductions $2,000 + $3,200 + $960 = $6,160, sold for $7,000. Adjusted basis $3,840, gain $3,160; 'Gain treated as ordinary income (lesser of line 3 or line 5) $3,160' — Form 4797 line 25b, then line 13 and line 17 to Schedule 1 line 4.
